# GitHub Copilot instructions

Use `AGENTS.md` for repository-level requirements, security constraints, implementation workflow and architecture. This is **SwiftDrop v1.3**, **not** a monolith or the superseded REST-only/RabbitMQ setup. REST commands/simple reads, read-only GraphQL dashboard queries, private gRPC, Kafka status events and SSE. Respect owners from `docs/team/OWNERSHIP.md`. The repo initially contains documentation/placeholder READMEs only; do not generate source code outside an explicit scoped task. Never invent test evidence or accept client-side authorization as sufficient.
